name: Property Traversal
description: A core Typed Data property-path traversal service, shaped to stand alone as its own project.
project_description: An API-only helper submodule of Entity Segment (shaped to stand alone). It provides a single service, property_traversal.fetcher (Drupal\property_traversal\PropertyTraversalInterface), that walks dot-separated Typed Data property paths across entity references over core's own Typed Data definitions. Its distinguishing behavior over core's EntityDataDefinition is unioning a hop target's configurable fields across its bundles, so a reference chain like field_ref.entity.some_field does not degrade to base fields only. Modelled on Search API's FieldsHelper but with no dependency on Search API or the typed_data contrib module. Ships no UI, entity, or config, and depends solely on core.
